beats.label: hook
beats.text: The team behind Hitman built a Bond game — and Bond literally cannot pull his gun first.

beats.label: gameplay
beats.text: You play a 26-year-old MI6 rookie on his very first mission, before the legend, before the gadgets. You sneak through embassies, pickpocket guards, smooth-talk past checkpoints, and rely on Q-Watch tech. Guns only unlock the moment an enemy escalates to lethal force — they call it the Licence to Kill system.

beats.label: standout
beats.text: It's a 20-hour single-player campaign across 15 missions, built on IO Interactive's Glacier engine with full ray tracing. No live service. No microtransactions. Just one complete Bond story.

beats.label: cta
beats.text: 007 First Light releases May 27 on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X. Wishlist on Steam now.
